title: Data Engineer
description:
FanDuel Group is a world-class team of brands and products that deliver sports betting, gaming and entertainment to millions of US sports fans every day. That’s no easy task and wouldn't be possible without a fantastic team who have helped us pioneer new products and innovative features that make us a leader in the industry.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We are seeking a Data Engineer to help lead the technical design and implementation of our most critical data infrastructure and products. You’ll be responsible for designing scalable systems, setting data architecture standards, and solving complex technical challenges that power analytics, data science, and business function use cases across the company.

You will work closely with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to architect data solutions that are performant, reliable, and built with a long-term, customer-centric mindset.

If you’re excited by this challenge and want to work within a dynamic company, then we’d love to hear from you.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

Implement High-Impact Data Systems

  • Implement and help design scalable, maintainable, and secure real-time and streaming data infrastructure and architectures that support enterprise-wide data needs

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Our Company
 At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.
 Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.
 We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.
 With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.
 The Role
 Our Data Engineering team is growing! We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our team in London.
 In this role you will build and run the pipelines behind QiCore, our new data warehouse. You’ll bring acquired businesses like Rewards into one platform and make sure the data the business runs on is reliable, governed and built to last.
 Key Responsibilities
 Build, test and maintain batch and streaming pipelines into QiCore to agreed engineering standards
 Migrate Rewards data into our warehouse and single customer view, keeping reporting running throughout
 Model data for analytics and reporting, working to the architecture and governance principles the team sets
 Monitor pipeline health and data quality, fixing issues at the root rather than patching symptoms
 Support future acquisitions and platform migrations, turning each one into a faster, repeatable process
 About You
 Several years of hands-on data engineering, writing production SQL and Python
 Experience building ETL or ELT pipelines on a modern cloud warehouse or big data platform
 Proven experience working with GCP and the Google ecosystem (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, etc.)
 Working knowledge of data governance, testing and data quality practices

title: Senior Data Engineer Datenplattform
description:
Für die Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Datenplattform auf Databricks sucht ein Agile Release Train im Bereich Data & Analytics bei einer Krankenversicherung erfahrene Data Engineers. Im Fokus stehen skalierbare Datenpipelines und Datenprodukte, die Umsetzung von Data-Vault-Modellen und der stabile, wirtschaftliche Betrieb der Datenlösungen im Azure-Umfeld. Du arbeitest als Teil des Data-Teams und bringst die Plattform mit deiner Erfahrung in Databricks, dbt Core und Data Vault technisch voran.
 Aufgaben
 Entwicklung und Betrieb skalierbarer Datenpipelines und Datenprodukte auf Databricks
 Umsetzung von Datenmodellen nach Data Vault 2.0 inkl. historisierter und dimensionaler Modelle
 Entwicklung von Transformationen, Datenqualitätstests und Dokumentation mit dbt Core
 Weiterentwicklung der Datenplattform mit Python, SQL und Apache Spark / PySpark
 Aufbau und Pflege von CI/CD-Prozessen sowie automatisierten Tests
 Sicherstellung eines stabilen und wirtschaftlichen Betriebs der Datenlösungen im Azure-Umfeld
 Zusammenarbeit im agilen Team und aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung der Plattform
 Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Data Engineering, idealerweise mehrjährig im Konzernumfeld
 Fundierte Kenntnisse in Databricks, SQL, Python und Apache Spark / PySpark sowie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb skalierbarer Datenpipelines
 Fundierte Erfahrung mit dbt Core auf Databricks und in der Datenmodellierung nach Data Vault 2.0, inkl. historisierter und dimensionaler Datenmodelle, Datenqualitätstests und Dokumentation
 Erfahrung mit Git, CI/CD und automatisierten Tests
 Sichere Arbeitsweise in agilen Teams, Erfahrung mit SAFe von Vorteil
 Domänenerfahrung im Krankenversicherungsbereich von Vorteil
 Hohe Eigenverantwortung sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
 Ausgeprägte Lernbereitschaft und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte selbstständig zu analysieren und neue Technologien rasch anzuwenden

title: Data Engineer
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Lyft is looking for experienced software engineers from a scope of disciplines. We are growing our team with people who want to build, improve and incorporate technologies that make the lives of our community more enriched. As an engineer at Lyft, you'll collaborate with teams like product, data science, analytics, and operations on code that empower us to iterate quickly, while focusing on delighting our riders and drivers.
 As a Software Engineer for Lyft Ads - you will work on one of Lyft’s newest lines of business focused on building the world’s largest transportation media network. We build products that allow brands to engage with our unique audience throughout their transportation journeys and beyond. For this role we are seeking software engineers who are passionate about backend and data engineering . You will join our Ad Infra Engineering team and contribute to building the systems and pipelines powering our ad-serving, measurement and audience platform. We work on technologies that let brands engage with our unique audience throughout their transportation journeys. This role is a great opportunity for an early-career engineer to gain experience working with distributed backend systems and large-scale data workflows, collaborating closely with product, analytics, and data science teams.
 Responsibilities:
 Develop and maintain backend systems that support real-time ad serving, campaign management, and reporting.
 Design and implement scalable data models to support analytics, targeting, and measurement use cases.
 Build and maintain data pipelines that handle ingestion, transformation, and distribution of large volumes of advertising data.

title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
description:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

 

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.

description:
Who is Artefact?
Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm that transforms organizations through data and AI. With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. From our Lausanne and Zurich offices, we help leading Swiss and international companies turn data and AI into measurable results, working with the leading data platforms, including Databricks.

You will design and deliver the data platforms our clients run their business and their AI on, combining hands-on engineering with client advisory.

Engineer first, consultant second, with a track record of shipping to production.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

title: Staff Analytics Engineer
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase .
 Finance Analytics builds Coinbase's financial data and reporting foundations so Finance, Accounting/Controllership, Treasury and FP&A can run accurate, timely and auditable operations. We sit at the intersection of data engineering, data science and business analytics: we own the source-of-truth financial datasets in Snowflake/Databricks, the pipelines that produce them, and the reconciliation, month-end close, safeguarding and reporting workflows built on top. We partner closely with Product Engineering to make sure upstream financial data is complete, reconciled and traceable.
 What you'll be doing:
 As the Staff Analytics Engineer on Finance Analytics, this person sets the technical direction for Coinbase's financial data layer and works side by side with Accounting, Controllership and FP&A. They need to understand how the books are closed, audited and controlled, not just how the data moves:
 Partner with Accounting and FP&A to support month-end and quarter-end close, building the datasets, reconciliations and reporting that let us close the books accurately and on time.
 Make financial data and pipelines audit-ready: SOX-compliant controls, lineage, change management and evidence for internal and external auditors.

title: Data Engineer, GTM Systems
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY; Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Anthropic's go-to-market teams are scaling quickly, and the decisions they make, from who to sell to and how to cover them to where to invest next, are only as good as the intelligence and infrastructure underneath them. As a Data Engineer on the GTM Systems data foundations team, you'll help build that layer: the data products that give sellers, operators, and analysts a rich, current, and trusted picture of the market, and the engineering rigor that lets our GTM systems run reliably as the business grows.
 This is an engineering role that goes beyond pipelines. You'll treat GTM data as a product and a platform: built once, kept current, and available wherever people work. Alongside the build, you'll help shape what the data means: how attributes are defined, which sources are trusted, and how the business puts them to use. The role sits at the intersection of the sales organization, the data organization, and the systems that data flows through. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy and Operations, Finance, Data Science, and the central data engineering team.
 Key responsibilities
 Bring disparate internal and external sources together: orchestrate, model, and normalize first-party product and revenue data alongside third-party data into one usable understanding of the company landscape
 Build and maintain identity and entity resolution, so every source attaches to one trusted record for each company and the relationships between companies are clear
 Help build the canonical layer where key attributes are defined once and mean the same thing everywhere, with clear sourcing logic, provenance, and freshness
